items.sourceText:
# 岚桥住房项目预售监管专户拨款细则

版本 LQ-3，自2026年9月1日起用于岚桥东苑，不适用于物业维修金。项目标记为🏗️东苑。专户余额不等于可拨款余额；监管行不承诺工程收益，施工单位不得凭销售人员的口头确认提款。

## 内部办理札记 A：Building identity before progress review

The intake desk receives one folder bearing the marketing name East Court and another bearing the construction name East Block. The names alone do not establish whether the folders refer to the same building. The desk asks the construction party to provide the approved mapping between the project register and the building register, attaches that mapping without rewriting the source documents, and records who supplied it. A photograph with a visible tower label can help locate the building but cannot cure a missing mapping in the register.

The progress reviewer then reads the building-specific certificates rather than applying the most advanced building's stage to the entire development. A shared crane, an access road and a common sales office are not proof that two towers have identical construction status. When a certificate covers several towers, the reviewer identifies which lines support the requested tower and marks the others as background. The archive retains the entire certificate so a later reviewer can see its original scope.

A clerk once copied a completion note from the neighboring tower because both folders used the same contractor. The corrected file keeps the mistaken note, labels it superseded for this application, and links the replacement evidence. The correction is a document-association repair. It does not certify an engineering stage, raise the fixed regulatory base or authorize any payment.

## 进度确认

每次申请须同时具备监理签章的进度表、建设方付款指令和现场照片索引。主体封顶只有完成质检备案后才计为封顶节点；监理写了‘已封顶’但备案未落库，仍沿用地下结构节点。材料齐全的登记时间只决定队列顺序，不自动满足节点条件。

## 内部办理札记 B：Cash snapshot and bank movements

The cash reviewer works from a dated account snapshot and its matching movement file. A promised purchaser payment stays on the forecast list until it is actually reflected in the account. A debit request awaiting bank execution is listed as an outstanding instruction rather than a completed disbursement. Review staff reconcile the snapshot time with the movement file so the same transfer is neither missed nor counted twice around the cut-off.

If an instruction was rejected for an invalid payee record, the failed attempt remains in the operational log. It does not become an actual payment merely because a confirmation screen was printed before execution failed. A later successful replacement receives a link to the failed attempt and its own execution evidence. Staff must not erase the failed attempt to make the history appear simpler, because that history explains why the file contains several apparently identical amounts.

The weekly supervisor compares opening cash, completed credits and completed debits to closing cash. This reconciliation explains the balance, while the regulatory calculation independently determines how much may be approved. A reconciled balance is necessary accounting context, but cannot substitute for a progress certificate or the required reserve. A financial forecast may assist planning without becoming cash available for today's approval.

## 内部办理札记 C：Scope of the construction invoice

A construction invoice may contain work on the requested tower, equipment stored for a later phase and consulting work for the developer's head office. The file should explain which items correspond to the submitted payment instruction. Intake staff may ask for an itemized schedule and the relevant contract reference; they cannot rewrite the invoice or invent a split that the construction party has not confirmed. The original invoice remains attached alongside the explanation.

The evidence team records delivery or service acceptance separately from the invoice date. A dated invoice does not prove that the work reached the regulatory milestone. Equally, a milestone certificate does not prove that every invoiced line belongs to this project. Those two questions are reviewed using different records, and a reviewer signs only the conclusion supported by the records assigned to that review role.

For example, a supplier includes replacement fencing after a storm in the same invoice as ordinary site services. The construction party must identify whether a request is an ordinary progress payment or a documented hazard-removal request. Its description cannot silently move the entire invoice into the exceptional channel. The final file retains the classification, supporting evidence and approval route, without treating an accounting label as authorization.

## 累计上限表

| 已确认节点 | 可累计拨付占监管基数 |
| --- | --- |
| 地下结构验收 | 35% |
| 主体封顶且备案完成 | 65% |
| 竣工验收登记 | 85% |
| 首次交付满90日且无停工处置 | 100% |

监管基数在项目建档时固定，不随当日销售回款增加。上表是累计比例，不是本次申请比例。

## 内部办理札记 D：Photo index and site evidence

The photo index is an index, not a substitute for the images it names. Each entry should allow the reviewer to retrieve the image associated with the relevant building and inspection visit. An image of the sales exhibition model is useful publicity material but cannot show the site's actual structural condition. A general aerial image can establish context while a building-specific certificate establishes the stage used for the calculation.

When an image is resubmitted after a labeling mistake, staff preserve the original image and the corrected label as separate items. They do not alter the photograph to draw in a date or a tower name that was never visible. The supervisor checks the explanation for the correction against the visit log. A legible caption is not evidence that the underlying visit actually occurred on the claimed date.

A common review problem is a folder of many photographs with no relationship to the payment application. More images do not necessarily add more support. The construction party prepares a cross-reference from the payment request to the relevant inspection and index entries. The reviewer records unresolved gaps explicitly. A request may remain incomplete even when its image folder is large, and a completed image check does not by itself change the approved engineering milestone.

## 内部办理札记 E：Two applications on the same day

Two applications can refer to different invoices while drawing on the same regulatory account. The reviewer must know which approved instructions have actually been executed by the time the second calculation is prepared. The applications are not independent merely because they have different folder numbers. At the same time, an unexecuted request should not be misrepresented as an actual disbursement in the historical paid figure.

The queue report identifies each request as incomplete, under review, approved for execution, executed or returned. These operational labels help staff avoid promising the same cash twice. The cash desk checks the current position before execution and refers a changed position back for recalculation rather than relying on an outdated printout. A queue position never guarantees a particular amount of regulatory headroom.

In a training incident, the morning reviewer printed an approval worksheet and the afternoon desk received a corrected bank statement. Staff retained both versions and recorded why the later worksheet replaced the earlier one before execution. They did not backdate the corrected snapshot. The purpose of versioning is to make the decision reproducible from the information available at the time, while leaving the core milestone and retention rules intact.

## 凭证归档与队列

经办先给资料包编号，再把影像交给复核员；复核员查验签章、照片日期和备案回执是否对应同一楼栋。跨楼栋的照片可作背景附件，但不能替代目标楼栋凭证。退回补正保留原编号，重新排队以最后一项补正材料的登记时间为准。每周报表列示待复核金额，只用于在途追踪，不能计入已拨金额，也不改变累计比例。

## 内部办理札记 F：Returned applications and the correction trail

A return notice identifies the missing or inconsistent items in one coherent list. It should distinguish a document that was never supplied from a document that was supplied but cannot be linked to the requested building. That distinction helps the applicant correct the file without replacing valid evidence unnecessarily. A desk note saying only incomplete does not explain what must be supplied or why the reviewer could not proceed.

When replacement material arrives, staff associate it with the original application identifier and record the registration time of the final correction. The preserved identifier supports audit continuity. It is not a promise that the application keeps its old queue priority. Staff must be able to reconstruct which material was available at the first submission and which only arrived after the return.

An applicant may withdraw a questionable certificate and supply a different certificate rather than editing the first one. The archive keeps the withdrawn certificate clearly labeled as unused in the final decision. This avoids a later reviewer accidentally relying on an obsolete attachment. The approval worksheet lists the evidence versions actually relied on, while the historical folder remains complete enough to explain the sequence of corrections.

## 留存与本次计算

无论节点比例如何，拨后必须留存监管基数的20%作为续建保障；达到首次交付满90日且无停工处置时才解除此留存。可拨余额取‘节点累计上限减已实际拨付’与‘专户现金减应留存’两者较小值，负数按零处理。本次批准额再取可拨余额与本次申请额的较小值。

## 内部办理札记 G：Hazard-removal work orders

The hazard-removal file describes the immediate site hazard, the work needed to remove it and the connection between that work and the requested payment. A contractor's general statement that all construction work improves safety does not distinguish emergency work from routine progress work. Staff ask for a specific work order and the relevant site record, preserving ordinary progress work as a separate request when the invoice contains both types.

The operational team assembles the supporting packet before routing it to the two named roles in the core exceptional procedure. One role's signature cannot be copied into the other role's approval box. A staff absence is addressed through a documented assignment to an authorized replacement, not by assuming the applicant can sign for the absent reviewer. The file should show whose decision was actually made and on which evidence.

After an emergency instruction is executed, the cash movement is linked back to that instruction and remains part of the account's paid history. The exceptional route changes which purpose may be considered during a stop-work situation; it does not create an account outside the regulatory calculation. Staff do not mark the payment invisible in cumulative reports simply because it passed through a different operational queue.

## 内部办理札记 H：Site resumption and administrative flags

The developer may notify the bank that work has resumed, while the regulatory system still shows a stop-work risk flag. The notification is filed promptly, but staff do not overwrite the flag merely to make the dashboard match the developer's announcement. The supporting resumption inspection record must be identifiable and associated with the same site before the operational record can support the required change.

Different events can happen on different dates: physical workers return, a supervisor visits, a resumption record is issued, and a clerk registers the record. These dates should not be collapsed into one date chosen for convenience. A visit diary may explain the chronology, but it does not replace the formal record referred to by the core stop-work procedure. Reviewers record uncertainty instead of inferring that all administrative steps were complete on the earliest date.

If a dashboard has not yet refreshed after a valid update, the desk resolves the discrepancy through the responsible record owner and preserves the confirmation. It does not bypass the condition by taking a screenshot of a different environment. The approval file needs a traceable operational state, not merely a reassuring picture. This discipline prevents an ordinary progress payment from being accidentally processed under the emergency description.

东苑演算台账：监管基数1000万元，当前专户现金700万元，已实际拨付200万元，封顶已备案，申请500万元。台账数字仅用于本细则演算，不代表任何真实项目。其他未付款工程合同不得先行冲减现金。

## 内部办理札记 I：Final approval and transfer execution

An approved amount and an executed amount can differ if an instruction fails before funds leave the account. The execution team returns the discrepancy to the reviewer and records the outcome. It cannot manufacture a completed movement by marking the approval form paid. A replacement instruction is checked against the current account position and linked to the original decision, so a failed transfer and a successful transfer are not both counted as cash leaving.

Before execution, staff compare the payee in the signed instruction with the verified contract record in the file. This casebook deliberately contains no actual payee account details. A request to change payee information requires supporting documentation and verification through the authorized business channel. A message attached to the application is context to be checked, rather than a self-authenticating command to redirect the payment.

After execution, the archive includes the bank movement reference and the amount actually transferred. The review worksheet remains a record of the calculation and approvals, while the execution evidence establishes what happened to cash. An auditor should be able to move from a report total to the underlying movement and then to the reviewed application without relying on a staff member's memory of an informal conversation.

## 内部办理札记 J：Project base and sales reporting

Sales staff maintain a running report of reservations, signed contracts and purchaser receipts. Those figures may change throughout the week and may help the project explain expected inflows. The fixed regulatory base used in the core rule is a different field in the project register. Staff should not copy the current sales report total into that field simply because both numbers are denominated in money and appear on the same dashboard.

A canceled reservation does not by itself demonstrate that the regulatory base has been amended, just as a new receipt does not increase the base automatically. If the project register has an authorized administrative correction, the supporting correction record must be reviewed as such. This casebook does not create a new power to revise the base or a new formula for doing so. Unresolved base-record discrepancies are referred to the register owner before the calculation is signed.

The monthly pack places the sales forecast and the regulatory worksheet in separate sections. Each section states its measurement date and purpose. A comparison chart may show them side by side to explain liquidity pressure, but the chart must not imply that forecast sales are available cash or that the highest commercial estimate sets the regulatory threshold. Presentation convenience cannot alter the meaning of the source fields.

## 停工例外

有有效停工风险标记时，普通进度款暂停；仅现场排险支出可走专项通道，要求监管行风险岗与住建联络岗双签。排险款仍计入累计已拨付，不豁免20%留存。停工标记解除须有复工查验记录，建设方自行宣布复工无效。

## 内部办理札记 K：Historical worksheets and current decisions

A folder may contain an old worksheet prepared before the current edition took effect. Staff retain that worksheet to explain the historical decision. They label its edition and decision status instead of replacing its numbers with current values, because doing so would make the historical bank movement difficult to reconcile. A worksheet can remain historically accurate while being unsuitable for a new application.

The reviewer of a current request identifies whether the packet contains a completed historical approval or material awaiting fresh approval after correction. A cover page saying originally submitted earlier is insufficient to settle that distinction. The relevant record is the decision event described by the core transition provision. A reopened document is not allowed to borrow the status of an unrelated completed approval simply because the amounts or contractor names happen to match.

In a training discussion, a staff member proposed updating every old spreadsheet to the new edition for visual consistency. The supervisor rejected that approach and required separate historical and current worksheets. The current worksheet states which source records were consulted, while the old worksheet keeps its original purpose. Neither edition is inferred from the date a file was copied to a new folder or from the software used to print it.

## 版本沿革

LQ-2曾规定封顶累计70%、续建留存15%；LQ-3将两项分别改为65%和20%。2026年9月1日前已最终批准的单笔按原批准额执行，之后新申请及补正后重新审批的单笔均用LQ-3。旧版只用于解释历史回单，不得套用于新单。

## 内部办理札记 L：First delivery and unresolved construction issues

The delivery file can contain invitation letters, key-collection appointments, handover records and defect lists. They are not interchangeable proof of the same event. Staff identify the event and record relevant to the core retention-release condition, rather than using the earliest promotional announcement as if it were completed delivery. This operational appendix does not replace the core elapsed-time or stop-work condition with a different threshold.

A defect list is recorded with its status and responsible party. The presence of a minor item on that list does not permit staff to invent a new universal release rule, and the absence of a complaint in the customer-service inbox does not establish that every regulatory condition has been met. The payment reviewer uses the documented conditions and their formal records, leaving technical defect judgments with the appropriate construction review function.

When handover evidence is corrected, the chronology records both the originally reported event and the correction. Staff should explain whether the correction changes a date used in the current review or merely clarifies an address. An address clarification should not silently restart an elapsed period; conversely, a genuinely corrected event date cannot be ignored just to preserve the result on an earlier worksheet. The final approval cites the record actually used.

## 内部办理札记 M：Read-only audit access

An internal auditor receives copies of the approved worksheet, supporting evidence index and movement reconciliation for a selected application. The audit copy is marked with its extraction time and source folder. Providing a copy does not grant authority to change the operational queue, sign a payment instruction or amend a construction certificate. Questions raised by the auditor are recorded as review findings rather than executed as direct banking instructions.

The evidence index should contain enough information to locate a source without unnecessarily exposing unrelated commercial material. For example, a certificate covering several projects can be retained in full in the controlled archive while the audit working pack clearly identifies the section relevant to the selected project. The working pack must not pretend that an extract is the whole original or omit a qualification that changes the meaning of the selected section.

If the auditor notices a missing execution reference, staff add a correction record linking the genuine bank movement. They do not write an invented reference to close the finding quickly. A finding remains open when evidence is unavailable, with the consequence for the decision stated honestly. The absence of an archive item cannot be cured by citing a summary report that was itself generated from the same incomplete file.

## 可查资料边界

本材料包含节点、留存、停工通道和示例台账，不含施工方银行账号、监管行柜员私人联系方式或任何真实项目的财务数据。业务联系须通过另行签署的监管协议。

## 内部办理札记 N：Handover between review teams

During staff rotation, the outgoing reviewer prepares a handover note listing open applications, unresolved evidence issues and the latest reviewed account snapshot. The incoming reviewer checks the links and identifies which conclusions were already formally signed. A personal handover note can explain work in progress, but it cannot add an approval that is absent from the controlled record. The date of the handover is not substituted for the dates of the underlying business events.

The note separates engineering questions, documentation questions and cash-reconciliation questions. This prevents a completed photograph check from being reported as completion of every review task. If a calculation was only a draft, the handover labels it draft and identifies its inputs. The new reviewer can reproduce or replace the draft while preserving it, and must review changed inputs before relying on it for a transfer.

A manager may reassign an incomplete application to balance workload. Reassignment is recorded so the archive explains who worked on the file. It does not change the application's last correction time or reserve a different place in the queue. The incoming team follows the same core conditions and uses the same source evidence standards. Operational convenience is not an independent basis for relaxing milestone, cash or retention requirements.

## 内部办理札记 O：Report totals and exception narratives

Management reports often combine application counts, requested amounts, approved amounts and executed amounts. The report defines each column so readers do not add them together as though they were independent uses of cash. A request returned and later resubmitted is linked in the application history; the report explains whether its count measures submissions or distinct applications. Counting a resubmission for workload analysis does not mean cash was disbursed twice.

An exception narrative states the particular reason a file took a different operational route. It should describe the supporting record and the authorized decision, not simply call the transaction special. The narrative cannot expand the legal purpose of a regulatory account or waive conditions that the core rule leaves in place. Reviewers should be able to understand which condition was checked, which route was used and which ordinary limits still applied.

For reconciliation, management may compare the total executed during a period with the change in cumulative paid history. Differences can arise from timing corrections or a movement assigned to a different reporting date. Staff explain these differences using the movement file and preserved correction trail. They do not alter historical approvals to force two reports to agree. A clear explanation of a difference is better evidence than silently editing the underlying record.

items.question: 栖衡少交演练接受950吨，货款、违约赔偿、担保外补赔各多少？

gold.referenceAnswer: 货款950×80=76000元；全差额50吨×(92−80)=600元赔偿；500元担保先抵赔偿，仍补100元，不自动抵货款。
requiredFacts: 担保不自动抵正常货款

evidence.text: 交收前一工作日17:00前双方确认可交割名册。交收日12:00前卖方完成配额过户，买方在15:00前付对应已交量货款，未交量不先付款。合同允许交量在名义量的98%至102%之间（含边界），双方不另签数量变更；货款按实际合格交量乘合同单价，不能按名义量付款。年度或账户不匹配的配额一律不计合格交量。
差额平仓：卖方少交且买方选择接受实际量时，少交差额=名义量−实际合格交量；赔偿额=少交差额×max(替代采购参考价−合同单价,0)。参考价取约定报价页交收日16:00的可核验值。价格差为负时赔偿为零，不要求买方倒贴。容差不是赔偿扣除额，跌出容差后须按全部少交差额算，不只按超出2%的部分算。
担保款划付顺序：先抵已确定违约赔偿，再抵已确定迟延费，余额退回缴存方，不自动抵正常货款。担保款不足时不足额仍应补付，不以没收担保款作为责任上限。正常完成交收并完成双方对账后两个工作日内退担保款；有挂起争议的，保留争议部分，未争议余额按期退回。
少交演练：合同名义1000吨，单价80元/吨；交收日合格到账950吨，买方按时选择接受950吨并差额平仓，16:00可核验替代采购参考价92元/吨。卖方已缴担保款500元，没有迟延费。另一条正常演练到账990吨且年度账户匹配，其他条件同上；两条演练相互独立。

栖衡碳配额远期交收约定 QH-4
本约定为虚构企业间人民币结算业务，不是真实交易所规则。2026年10月1日起签订的合同适用。标的是指定年度碳配额，单位为吨，不能以项目减排量替代。交收量以登记系统实际划入合约约定账户的可用配额为准；转出申请截图不是交收回单。

附录甲：Counterparty preparation and authority records

Before a new fictional carbon forward is placed in the delivery queue, the operations team associates the legal party name on the signed contract with the party name in the registry instructions. A trading desk nickname is not sufficient to establish that association. Staff keep the signed authority record and the registry instruction together so a later reviewer can identify which party authorized the nominated receiving account. This appendix intentionally supplies no real registry account number.

The file distinguishes authority to negotiate a trade from authority to change the account used for delivery. A trader may explain a commercial instruction while the controlled account amendment still requires verification through the agreed business channel. An attachment received in a chat is checked against the formal record instead of being treated as an executable instruction merely because it contains the correct nominal quantity.

If two companies in the same group use similar names, staff do not assume that their accounts or contracts are interchangeable. The exception is referred back for a documented party mapping or an authorized contract amendment. Neither a shared office address nor a common parent permits a clerk to reroute allowance delivery. The original instructions remain available in the archive alongside any later approved correction, with the scope of the correction stated explicitly.

交收前一工作日17:00前双方确认可交割名册。交收日12:00前卖方完成配额过户，买方在15:00前付对应已交量货款，未交量不先付款。合同允许交量在名义量的98%至102%之间（含边界），双方不另签数量变更；货款按实际合格交量乘合同单价，不能按名义量付款。年度或账户不匹配的配额一律不计合格交量。

附录乙：Vintage checks in the registry export

The registry export may show balances for several allowance years in neighboring columns. The allocation analyst first locates the year named by the contract, then checks whether the listed balance is available for transfer. A positive total at the bottom of the export is not proof that the contracted year has enough available units. Historical holdings and surrendered units can appear in an export for information without becoming eligible delivery inventory.

The analyst stores the export time and the field definitions with the file. A spreadsheet that has lost its headers is returned for clarification rather than reconstructed from column position alone. When the registry changes the order of columns, an old spreadsheet formula may still produce a plausible total while selecting the wrong year. The reviewer therefore checks the source labels instead of relying only on the absence of a spreadsheet error message.

In a training file, the seller initially supplied a balance page containing the correct company but a different vintage. Staff retained it as an incorrect submission and asked for the relevant record. The later correct-year export was assessed on its own availability and timestamp. The first submission did not reserve delivery time for a later transfer, and a correct party name could not cure the wrong allowance year.

数量容差仅用于交收完成的判断。若实际合格交量落在98%至102%之外，买方可选择接受实际量并以名义量和实交量的差额结算违约，或拒绝整批并启动全量平仓；须在当日16:00前通知。买方没有在期限内选择，不等于自动接受或自动拒绝，应进入争议挂起，不释放担保款。

附录丙：Nomination lists and later corrections

The pre-delivery nomination list records which contract, allowance year and delivery instruction the parties have confirmed. Its purpose is to make the coming transfer identifiable. It is not evidence that the transfer has already happened. Operations archive the confirmed list and retain later amendments separately, so a reviewer can distinguish a planning change from an actual registry movement.

Where a list contains a duplicated line, the parties correct the list by identifying the duplicated contract reference and preserving the reason for removal. Staff do not delete an actual transfer simply because the nomination spreadsheet once contained an error. Registry movement evidence and the parties' list are reconciled, and unexplained differences are escalated rather than forced to agree by changing a quantity in the bank reconciliation.

A seller may discuss an anticipated inventory change before delivery. That discussion is recorded as context until the formal instruction is confirmed. It does not expand the quantity tolerance or replace the contract's year requirement. The reviewer checks whether a proposed correction changes a commercial term that needs an authorized amendment, or merely fixes an obvious clerical label. A clerical label repair cannot be used to conceal a change of buyer or a substitution of a different environmental asset.

登记与资金核对分两组操作。配额组查验配额年度、账户及可用状态，资金组查验交易号、到账金额和付款户名；单组完成核对不能代替另一组结论。同一企业可能在多个年度有配额余额，导出的余额总表只可用来定位记录，不能把不同年度配额加总当作本合约可交量。过户过程中被冻结的配额不计入可用量，解除冻结后也要按实际可用时点判断是否逾期。

业务员可以联系客户解释缺件，但不得在对账表中手工把‘待审核’改成‘已过户’。配额组发现年度错误时应保留错误回单及更正轨迹；如果正确年度的替代配额在截止后才到账，需按迟延条款重新核对，不得把错误年度的首次提交时间移作正确到账时间。资金组发现付款户名与合约不同，先走第三方付款核验，不能因为金额刚好匹配就直接结清。

附录丁：Transfer status and the receiving ledger

A transfer can be prepared, submitted, under review, rejected or completed. The operations ledger uses these labels to track work without implying that every submitted transfer has reached the receiving account. Staff retrieve the registry evidence associated with the final completed movement and check the eligible available balance it created for the nominated receiver. An intermediate screen can explain a delay but does not replace completed delivery evidence.

If the registry rejects a submission and the seller resubmits, the new attempt is linked to the rejected attempt. Both histories remain visible. Reusing the commercial contract reference does not make the rejected attempt a second delivery, and it does not backdate the completed attempt. The analyst avoids adding quantities from status messages that describe different stages of the same movement.

The receiving side reconciles actual credited quantities to the contract and sends any disagreement through the agreed channel. A missing acknowledgement email is investigated using the registry record; an acknowledgement alone is not used to invent a credit that the registry cannot show. The file should allow another analyst to determine what was actually available, in which year, for which receiver and at what time, without relying on either trader's recollection of a telephone conversation.

附录戊：Combined deliveries for separate contracts

A seller may arrange several transfers during one session, and a registry movement report may show them next to each other. The analyst matches each movement to its designated contract before comparing delivery quantities. One contract's overdelivery is not automatically credited to another contract's shortfall, even when the parties are the same. A commercial offset requires its own documented agreement rather than an arithmetic shortcut in the reconciliation workbook.

When the parties authorize a combined operational instruction covering several contracts, the file retains the agreed allocation of the resulting quantities. The allocation should be identifiable from the instruction and completed movement evidence. Staff do not choose an allocation after seeing which contract would otherwise incur a shortfall, because that would replace the parties' agreed delivery record with an outcome-driven reconstruction.

A separate worksheet is kept for each contract's nominal quantity, eligible actual quantity and settlement decision. A summary can aggregate payment planning, but must leave a route back to those worksheets. The same registry units cannot be counted in two contracts. If the allocation remains disputed, the disputed contracts stay visibly unresolved and staff do not describe the portfolio as completely delivered merely because the aggregate number of units matches a portfolio total.

差额平仓：卖方少交且买方选择接受实际量时，少交差额=名义量−实际合格交量；赔偿额=少交差额×max(替代采购参考价−合同单价,0)。参考价取约定报价页交收日16:00的可核验值。价格差为负时赔偿为零，不要求买方倒贴。容差不是赔偿扣除额，跌出容差后须按全部少交差额算，不只按超出2%的部分算。

附录己：Payment instructions and separate bank evidence

The funding desk prepares a payment instruction after the eligible delivered amount is known under the applicable procedure. A bank message saying an instruction was created is different from a completed account debit. The desk retains the execution evidence and matches it to the agreed commercial reference. It does not use an expected payment in a treasury forecast to close an outstanding purchase price obligation.

If a bank rejects a payment because the receiving party details do not match, the rejected attempt remains in the record. The desk investigates the mismatch through controlled contact details and resubmits only after verification. A document claiming to correct a beneficiary name is treated as a proposed correction, not as automatic authority to replace the account instruction. This fictional casebook contains no real beneficiary data to be copied into an operational payment.

The accounts team tracks ordinary purchase price, agreed compensation, late charges and security movements as distinct items. A net display can be useful for management, but its underlying components must remain reconstructible. The fact that two amounts happen to be equal does not establish that one legally extinguished the other. Staff apply only the settlement treatment supported by the contract and the documented agreement, rather than inferring a right of set-off from a convenient bank transfer amount.

担保款划付顺序：先抵已确定违约赔偿，再抵已确定迟延费，余额退回缴存方，不自动抵正常货款。担保款不足时不足额仍应补付，不以没收担保款作为责任上限。正常完成交收并完成双方对账后两个工作日内退担保款；有挂起争议的，保留争议部分，未争议余额按期退回。

附录庚：Buyer election records outside the quantity band

Where actual eligible delivery falls outside the permitted quantity band, operations obtain the buyer's recorded election and associate it with the specific contract and delivery snapshot. A draft written by the seller does not establish what the buyer elected. The record should be clear enough to distinguish acceptance of the actual delivered quantity with a difference settlement from rejection of the entire batch and a full closeout path.

Staff retain the received time and the communication channel agreed for the election. A later discussion of possible settlement options is not silently substituted for the original election notice. If the notice is ambiguous, the ambiguity is referred to both parties for resolution and remains visible in the control log. The desk does not choose whichever interpretation produces the smaller compensation merely to close its daily report.

An election for one contract does not become a standing election for all contracts with the same seller. Likewise, acceptance of an earlier small deviation does not imply consent to a later outside-band delivery. The individual file records what was chosen for this delivery and what remained disputed. Silence is not converted into either acceptance or rejection by a spreadsheet default value, and unresolved security treatment remains subject to the original dispute procedure.

少交演练：合同名义1000吨，单价80元/吨；交收日合格到账950吨，买方按时选择接受950吨并差额平仓，16:00可核验替代采购参考价92元/吨。卖方已缴担保款500元，没有迟延费。另一条正常演练到账990吨且年度账户匹配，其他条件同上；两条演练相互独立。

附录辛：Evidence for the reference quotation

The quotation evidence identifies the agreed source page, its displayed date and the observation time relevant to the contract. An isolated number in a chat message cannot demonstrate that it came from that page at the required time. Analysts save enough of the original view to preserve qualifiers such as indicative, delayed or unavailable. Cropping away a qualifier can change the meaning of the quoted value and make a settlement calculation appear better supported than it is.

The analyst also records the unit and currency associated with the source. A page containing several instruments can display a plausible price next to the wrong allowance year or asset type. Staff match the instrument to the agreement before using the number. This appendix does not introduce a replacement source or authorize staff to average unrelated prices when the agreed value is absent.

When a quotation is corrected by the source publisher, operations keep the original capture and the correction notice, then refer the effect on settlement through the parties' documented resolution process. A clerk must not overwrite a previously used price without preserving why it changed. The calculation file needs to explain which verifiable input supported the agreed result. A numerical answer can be arithmetically correct yet unsupported if the source, time or instrument cannot be established.

登记系统故障例外：只有登记服务方公告覆盖该合约交收窗口的故障，才把配额过户期限延至恢复后首个工作日12:00。卖方本地网络故障不适用。付款时限改为实际合格过户当日15:00，担保款在实际完成对账前不释放；例外只调整时点，不把无效年度配额变为合格。

附录壬：Closeout calculation workbook review

The workbook separates the physical shortfall calculation from the price-difference calculation. Inputs are named so a reviewer can see whether the quantity is the nominal contracted amount or the actual eligible amount. This reduces the risk that an analyst uses the quantity tolerance as though it were an insurance deductible. The core closeout formula remains the governing formula; this casebook does not modify its treatment of the whole shortfall or the nonnegative price difference.

Reviewers compare the workbook to the recorded buyer election before checking the arithmetic. A worksheet for accepted actual delivery cannot be reused without review for a rejected batch, because the commercial path is different even if some input cells have the same values. A saved spreadsheet from another contract is a template for layout only. Its price, year, quantity and election must not silently become evidence for the present contract.

The signed calculation retains the input sources, workbook version and review conclusion. If the analyst finds a formula that references a hidden column, the error is corrected with an explanation and the prior draft is preserved. Staff do not treat a locked spreadsheet as proof of correctness. A second reviewer should be able to reproduce the result from the recorded contract and movement evidence without depending on undocumented formulas or a trader's private notes.

附录癸：Security ledger and unresolved items

Security receipts are matched to the party and contract for which the money was lodged. A group treasury transfer may cover several contracts, but the allocation needs a traceable record. The ledger does not assume that money pledged for one buyer can be applied to another buyer's claim. Unallocated receipts remain visibly unallocated until their purpose is verified, rather than being used to make a shortfall report appear fully funded.

The clearing officer distinguishes a claimed amount from an amount established for settlement. A claim letter may start a review without making every line immediately payable from security. The file shows which components are determined, which remain disputed and what authority supports any release or application. An operational hold is documented with its scope; staff should not expand a disputed component into a permanent retention of unrelated balances.

Following resolution, the officer reconciles security received, authorized applications and the remaining balance. A security statement and a purchase price statement remain distinct even when presented in one report. The remaining obligation is not automatically capped by the cash already lodged. The original contractual responsibility and the available security are different concepts, and a reconciliation must preserve that distinction instead of simply marking the file closed when the security account reaches zero.

交收档案必须能够重建一条完整时间线，包括名册确认、登记系统回单、买方数量选择通知、参考价截屏和最终资金对账表。参考价截屏要显示报价页名称、日期和时点；转发聊天中的一个数字无法证明它是约定16:00参考价。补录说明可以帮助复核，却不能改写原始回单时间。

如果报价页当日没有可核验的16:00值，按合同争议流程另行确定，不允许经办员从上周平均价、客户口述价或下一日成交价中任选一个。已确定赔偿项目和仍有争议的项目分栏列示，清算人员只能对已确定部分动用担保款；双方达成新和解时须保存书面版本和对应交易号。结算表的‘计划支付’用于资金安排，不是资金到账证明；‘已匹配到账’才可进入最终清偿记录。档案查询仅限本合同，不能将另一个年度合同的价格或数量直接带入。

附录子：Registry service interruption record

A reported interruption is checked against the registry service provider's notice and the contract's delivery window. A seller's workstation error, an expired local login and a service-wide outage are different events. Operations retain the provider's notice as well as the seller's incident report, so a reviewer can determine which event actually prevented processing. The presence of a help-desk ticket alone does not establish that the core service-outage exception applies.

The chronology records the announced service interruption, the announced restoration and the completed eligible transfer. If the seller continues to have a local problem after the service is restored, staff do not automatically extend the provider's outage period to match that local difficulty. The controlling exception remains the one in the core agreement, and the resulting payment timing is linked to actual eligible delivery.

During recovery, the operations team reconciles queued attempts before encouraging a resubmission. Otherwise a delayed original and a new attempt can both execute. If that happens, the extra transfer is not erased from the record; the parties identify and resolve it through the controlled correction process. Recovery work does not make the wrong allowance year eligible, eliminate the need for registry evidence or release security before the required reconciliation is complete.

QH-3把少交赔偿限定为担保款金额。QH-4取消此上限，以实际公式计算并可追补。10月1日前已签合同仍用QH-3；10月1日起新签合同用QH-4，不因沿用旧交易号前缀而适用旧版。交量98%至102%的容差两版相同。

附录丑：Year-end reporting and surrender context

An enterprise may discuss its expected compliance needs when negotiating the forward, but those commercial forecasts do not establish the enterprise's actual annual emissions gap. The delivery team records only the contract and eligible movement facts needed for this agreement. It does not certify the buyer's environmental compliance, issue a public sustainability claim or infer a surrendered quantity from the volume bought under one fictional contract.

The contract archive keeps delivery records separate from any later surrender records provided for context. Transfer to a buyer and surrender by that buyer are distinct registry events. A buyer can receive allowances without this casebook establishing what happens to them afterward. Staff therefore avoid describing a completed transfer as proof that a compliance obligation has been discharged, unless the relevant separate evidence is actually in the authorized file.

Marketing language about environmental benefits is not used as a price input, delivery confirmation or eligibility substitute. Analysts may quote the contractual purpose in a narrative, but must not replace the specified asset with a different environmental instrument because it appears to serve a similar purpose. This distinction is particularly important when a supporting presentation uses broad terms such as carbon units while the operative contract names a specific allowance year and receiving instruction.

本约定不载明实际配额登记账户号、未来市场碳价、企业年度排放履约缺口或另一个交易所的正式规则。演练参考价92元仅是设定，不是实时市场报价。

附录寅：Amendments, settlement letters and historical versions

A proposed commercial amendment is kept as a draft until the parties have executed it through their authorized process. Operations label drafts, signed amendments and settlement letters distinctly. A draft attached to an email does not automatically replace the original contract, and a settlement letter resolving one disputed amount does not necessarily rewrite all delivery terms for future contracts. The file states the scope actually agreed rather than assuming the broadest possible effect.

Historical versions of the agreement remain available to explain older transactions. The relevant signing event is verified from the contract record, not inferred from a copied filename or a reused trading reference. A new transaction using a familiar identifier prefix can still belong to the current version. Conversely, a historical contract is not silently moved into the new regime because staff scanned it with newer software.

When parties agree an exceptional resolution, the archive shows the original claim, the agreed outcome and the authority for that outcome. Analysts do not rewrite the original core rule to make the exceptional settlement look ordinary. This distinction allows later reviewers to understand both what the standard agreement required and what the parties subsequently resolved for a particular file. A historical compromise is not a universal precedent that staff can apply without checking its scope.

附录卯：Record corrections and independent reconciliation

Correction requests identify the specific record, proposed change and supporting evidence. A clerical transposition in a narrative may be corrected without changing the underlying movement. A proposed change to actual delivered quantity is a different matter and must be supported by the registry evidence. Staff keep these categories separate so the authority to fix a typo does not become authority to change the settlement basis.

The independent reconciler follows a chain from contract to nomination, movement, election, quotation, calculation and bank execution. Missing links are recorded as missing, with the affected conclusion left unresolved where necessary. A management summary that repeats the same unsupported figure is not independent corroboration. More copies of an error do not create additional evidence for it.

The final closing pack identifies the state of each obligation and the source of each material input. Forecast amounts remain labeled forecasts and disputed amounts remain labeled disputed. If a late document changes a conclusion, the pack preserves the earlier version and explains the change. The object is a reproducible business record rather than a visually tidy folder. Staff should be able to demonstrate which facts were known, which were agreed and which were still unavailable when each decision was made.

items.question: 澄屿系统暂停确认时，客户已扣款是否可当作已确认并换日补建订单？

gold.referenceAnswer: 不能。应进入待定队列，恢复后按公告处理，不得换日重建来替代原单，也不先给可赎份额。
forbiddenConfusions: 换日重建不会影响净值

evidence.text:
## 暂停与已受理单

登记系统暂停确认时，申请进入待定队列，不能因扣款成功自行视为已确认；恢复后按公告说明处理。正常情况下销售端可补查申请状态，但不得以新日期重建一个申请来替代原待定单，否则可能改变净值归属。客户如需退回，应通过原申请的撤回或异常处理流程登记，待定期间不先给出可赎份额。

items.answer: 不可以。登记系统暂停确认时，申请进入待定队列，不能因扣款成功自行视为已确认；恢复后按公告说明处理。销售端可补查申请状态，但不得以新日期重建一个申请来替代原待定单，否则可能改变净值归属。客户如需退回，应通过原申请的撤回或异常处理流程登记。
items.sourceText:
# 澄屿稳衡基金登记说明 CY-7

本材料及基金名称均为虚构，适用于2026年10月10日起受理的申购单。本基金实行未知价申购，提交时页面显示的上一交易日净值只是参考，不能锁定成交份额。基金份额登记与销售平台的支付状态分别记账，扣款成功不代表登记已确认。

## 受理日与撤单

开放日15:00之前（不含15:00）提交且款项同日到账，以当日为T日；15:00及以后或款项次日到账，顺延至同时满足提交时点与到账条件的下一开放日。非开放日的申请排至下一开放日，实际开放日见另行公告。撤单须在受理日15:00之前完成，15:00整不能撤销。

## 前端费率

| 单笔申请金额A | 申购费 |
| --- | --- |
| A＜100万元 | 0.8%比例费率 |
| 100万元≤A＜500万元 | 0.5%比例费率 |
| A≥500万元 | 每笔1000元固定费 |

比例档净申购金额=A÷(1+费率)，申购费=A−净申购金额；不是先从A直接乘费率扣除。固定费档则净申购金额=A−1000元。份额=净申购金额÷T日份额净值，到0.01份四舍五入；中间净申购金额保留高精度，不先取整。

## 支付与登记的接口口径

销售机构收到申请后先核对交易账户状态，再把申请金额、受理时间和到账流水关联提交。客户重复点击支付按钮时，支付平台可能生成多个尝试编号；只有最终对应到账流水的有效申请进入登记批次，失败尝试不能合并成一笔大额申请。客户使用两张银行卡分两次付款，销售平台若形成两个独立申请编号，登记仍按两笔费率处理；同一个有效申请编号的分次到账则以其全额到账时点判断是否进入受理日。金额相加是否跨费率档，不能脱离申请编号来判断。登记员只可补充到账关联，不能为了降低费率把两笔不同申请号手工拼成一笔。

## 确认与权益

常规申购T+1开放日登记确认；确认前不进入可赎份额。收益起点是登记确认日，不是银行扣款日。T+1遇非开放日顺延。确认份额与可赎份额的时间差用于防止尚未核准的申请被提前赎回，不意味着本基金承诺收益，宣传中的历史曲线不得拿来代替登记结果。

## 演练订单

订单甲申请100800元，T日净值1.2500元，满足常规受理条件且不受限购。订单乙和丙分别是同一天、同一客户、两个独立申请编号，各申请60万元；不适用机构专项费率。这三单独立演算，不能将订单甲的净值条件当作其他日期的实际净值。

## 限购日的比例确认

公告限购时，先对每个有效申请计算获配申请金额，再按获配金额重选上表费率档并计算份额；未获配部分原路退回，不收申购费。采用比例确认不是按原申请全额先收费再缩减份额。客户界面会同时展示申请金额与获配金额，费率档位应核对获配金额；仅看扣款总额容易误以为费率计算有误。退回款的银行处理时间另行通知，不以本说明的T+1确认时点保证到账。

## 暂停与已受理单

登记系统暂停确认时，申请进入待定队列，不能因扣款成功自行视为已确认；恢复后按公告说明处理。正常情况下销售端可补查申请状态，但不得以新日期重建一个申请来替代原待定单，否则可能改变净值归属。客户如需退回，应通过原申请的撤回或异常处理流程登记，待定期间不先给出可赎份额。

## 核对备忘：净值、金额和份额

净值公告通常带有估值日期和公告日期，晚间发布不表示次日净值；复核时应先找估值日期与订单T日是否一致。到账流水的日期只用于受理条件，不决定净值金额。登记回执中的确认份额用份作单位，申请金额与申购费用元作单位，不能把份额增加误读成现金返还。对于高金额订单，固定费用的门槛按人民币金额判断，不按外币付款的表面数值判断；本说明没有提供换汇汇率，外币资金必须经另行流程换成人民币并到账后才能套用本表。

份额尾差只在最终除以净值之后处理。复核员如果先把净申购金额到分取整，结果有时碰巧一样，但不能由一次相同结果证明步骤正确。费用对账分别记录申请额、净申购额、费用和最终份额；一笔订单的净申购额加费用应等于获配申请额。撤销后的订单保留审计记录，不再进入后续登记批次；客户重新提交是新申请，受理日、净值与限购状态均重新判断。

## 版本口径

CY-6比例确认后仍按原申请额选费率；CY-7改为按获配额重新选档。2026年10月10日起受理的订单采用CY-7，含此前预填但尚未受理的申请；已在10月9日受理的订单仍用CY-6，即使其确认日落在10月10日后。

## 资料边界

本说明不提供未来份额净值、保证收益率、销售机构完整开放日历或具体退款到账日。示例净值仅用于演算；遇开放日或额度问题应读取对应日期公告，不能由本说明推测。

items.question: Cedar9月30日结算旧资产产生的现金，触发期间残余还能按CE-8给次级吗？

gold.referenceAnswer: 不能。9月1日及以后结束的分配期间用CE-9，即使资产旧，触发残余仍留非受限现金。
requiredFacts: 触发残余留非受限现金

items.answer: 不能。CE-9规定，自2026-09-01（含）结束的分派期起，即使触发条件处于活动状态，残余也不再释放给次级，而是保留为不受限制的现金；该新规适用于包括CE-8下发起资产在内的资产，且不重新打开此前已完成的分派。因此，9月30日结算旧资产产生的现金，在触发期间不能按CE-8把残余分配给次级。

CEDAR EQUIPMENT TRUST | CASH MEMORANDUM CE-9 | 2026-09-01
This is a fictional closed trust, not a public investment offer. Amounts in the exercise
are thousands of CNY. Interest targets are accounting obligations for a period, not
guaranteed returns. A trustee fee cap and the reserve target are separate limits.
APPENDIX A | COLLECTION FILE INTAKE
The equipment servicer prepares a collection file from actual receipts and identifies the
asset reference for each entry. A lease invoice establishes a claim but does not establish
that cash has arrived. Staff compare the file with the relevant bank movements and retain
unmatched items for investigation. An unexplained difference is not filled with an
estimated receipt merely because the estimate would make the distribution worksheet
balance.
The collector's note can describe a tenant's promise to pay, an equipment purchaser's
installment plan or a disputed charge. These notes are useful operational context. They
remain separate from completed receipts until the supporting movement is available and
matched. A customer who confirms a payment has been initiated may still have supplied only
a remittance instruction, rather than evidence that the trust has received usable funds.
When an asset reference is missing, the receipt is held for identification under the
operational process. Review staff preserve the payer's message and the bank record while
asking the servicer to explain the association. They do not choose the asset with the most
overdue lease simply to improve a delinquency report. The completed file should allow
another analyst to reproduce which receipts supported the period's cash total and which
items were excluded or unresolved.
DISTRIBUTABLE CASH
Begin with period collections plus the opening unrestricted cash balance. Exclude money
held in the tax escrow and exclude unreceived sale proceeds. A signed equipment sale
contract is not collected cash. Restricted reserve cash is separate from the opening
unrestricted balance and is not added a second time.
APPENDIX B | OPENING BALANCE RECONCILIATION
The opening unrestricted cash balance is traced to the previous period's signed closing
position and subsequent authorized adjustments. A draft distribution proposal is not a
signed closing position. If the prior period retained cash, the reconciliation identifies
where that cash remained and why it is not also described as a new collection. The same
amount must not enter the present worksheet once as opening cash and again as a current
receipt.
A book entry correcting an earlier classification is supported by an explanation and the
relevant source record. Staff do not assume every unexplained difference is distributable
simply because it appears in a cash account report. Restricted balances, unresolved
receipts and amounts belonging to another vehicle can appear in operational views that were
not designed to be distribution statements. The reviewer checks the meaning of the fields
before using their totals.
The handover pack retains both the original prior-period report and the authorized
correction, when a correction exists. This makes a later change understandable without
pretending that staff had always reported the corrected number. A reconciliation can
explain an accounting difference; it does not by itself grant a new right to distribute
restricted money. The governing cash and reserve definitions remain the ones in the main
memorandum.
NORMAL WATERFALL
Apply distributable cash in this order: (1) trustee fee, capped at 5 each period; (2)
senior current interest and senior interest arrears; (3) refill the liquidity reserve to
its target; (4) junior current interest; (5) any residual to the junior capital account. An
unpaid fee above the cap is not moved into senior interest. Unpaid senior interest carries
forward without interest on interest.
APPENDIX C | TAX ESCROW SEPARATION
The tax escrow ledger is maintained separately from the unrestricted operating ledger.
Staff identify transfers into the escrow, authorized tax payments from it and any
unresolved tax reconciliation item. An escrow balance may be shown in an overall custody
report for completeness, but its inclusion in that report does not make it part of
distributable cash. The distribution analyst checks the account purpose as well as the
currency and balance.
A tax invoice and a completed escrow payment are different records. The invoice can explain
a liability while the movement establishes that money was used. If a payment is made from
escrow, the analyst does not deduct it again from an unrelated unrestricted collection
total unless there is a distinct supported transaction. Double recording an escrow use can
understate cash just as adding escrow to the waterfall can overstate it.
This appendix provides no investor tax rate or personal withholding rule. Operational staff
must not derive such a rate by dividing an escrow balance by a convenient receipt amount.
The escrow was established for its documented purpose and may relate to more than one
timing item. Investor tax questions require the separate applicable terms and records,
which are outside this fictional memorandum. A distribution calculation cannot create
missing tax instructions.
APPENDIX D | EQUIPMENT SALE STATUS
The asset manager tracks offers, signed sale contracts, delivery arrangements, invoiced
proceeds and actual collected proceeds as different stages. A signed sale contract may
justify a forecast in the planning report while leaving current distributable cash
unchanged until funds are received. The asset manager's estimate of the final resale value
is not a bank balance and should not be inserted into the present distribution to avoid a
projected shortfall.
If a purchaser pays an installment, staff match the actual receipt to the sale file and
retain the remaining amount as outstanding. The whole contract amount is not treated as
collected merely because one installment arrived. A deposit subject to a restriction is
classified under its actual terms instead of being assumed unrestricted. The cash analyst
requests clarification when a sale summary omits the status or restrictions associated with
an amount.
Canceled sales and returned deposits remain visible in the asset history. Staff do not
delete the old contract simply because it is no longer expected to complete. The archive
explains which receipts, refunds or unresolved claims resulted from it. None of these
operational events supplies a forecast equipment price for the exercise in the main
memorandum. That exercise is a closed snapshot and remains separate from the additional
casebook's hypothetical workflow.
CASH CONTROL NOTES
The servicing team records collection dates and asset references before sending the cash
file to the trustee. A buyer's promise to pay may be attached as a forecast, but must
remain outside the distributable cash total. Reconciliation matches the bank statement to
the file and explains outstanding items. Forecasts are useful for the next period's
planning; they cannot fund the present distribution. Tax escrow belongs in its own ledger
so an invoice paid from escrow does not appear again as an unrestricted cash expense.
APPENDIX E | TRUSTEE FEE REQUEST REVIEW
The trustee's request is reconciled to the service period and supporting fee notice before
being placed in the first waterfall step. A request can be larger than the amount permitted
at that step. The reviewer preserves the requested amount as a source fact while showing
the permitted application separately. Editing the request to equal the permitted
application would make the audit trail look simpler but would conceal the reason a
difference existed.
Staff do not relabel the unallocated part of a fee request as senior interest. The two
obligations have different sources and positions in the memorandum. A fee invoice cannot
become an interest arrears record just by moving its amount to another worksheet row. Any
unresolved treatment of a requested fee remains explicitly unresolved rather than being
pushed into an unrelated class to produce a fully paid report.
The signed notice identifies the fee actually applied in the distribution and the
supporting cap. A later correction to the source invoice is handled with its own record.
The correction does not retroactively authorize a draft allocation that was inconsistent
with the main waterfall. The casebook keeps invoice administration distinct from the
distribution priority so staff can discuss an invoice without silently changing the cash
rules for senior, reserve or junior payments.
RESERVE TARGET
The target is 40 while the performance trigger is clear. It becomes 70 when the trigger is
active. A refill uses the difference between the current reserve balance and the applicable
target, with a floor of zero. A reserve already above target does not pay a negative
refill; excess reserve is released only by a separately authorized release instruction.
APPENDIX F | SENIOR INTEREST REGISTER
The senior register distinguishes current interest, carried interest arrears and capital
balance. Staff trace each item to its relevant period and source record. A capital amount
cannot be inserted into the current interest line to accelerate a capital payment, and a
requested trustee fee cannot be entered as senior arrears. The headings are business
definitions, not free-form labels selected to obtain a preferred priority.
When previous senior interest was not paid, the arrears record carries the unpaid amount
forward under the main memorandum's treatment. The analyst retains the earlier signed
distribution notice to explain that amount. A planning spreadsheet may calculate
hypothetical future amounts, but those projections do not turn into actual arrears before
the relevant obligation arises. Reviewers compare both the amount and the obligation's
identity.
The interest register is reconciled after payment using actual execution evidence. An
approved payment that fails at the bank remains distinguishable from a completed
distribution. If the next worksheet uses a revised arrears position, the file explains the
failed or corrected movement. Staff should be able to reconstruct the register without
adding interest on unpaid interest where the main terms do not permit it. A spreadsheet's
automatic compounding function is not independent contractual authority.
PERFORMANCE TRIGGER
The trigger becomes active when the three-month average delinquency ratio is strictly above
4.0%. A value exactly 4.0% does not activate it. While active, junior current interest and
junior residual distributions are suspended; cash left after steps 1 through 3 remains in
unrestricted cash. Junior unpaid current interest is recorded, but does not jump ahead of
the reserve in the next period.
APPENDIX G | LIQUIDITY RESERVE MOVEMENTS
The reserve ledger identifies its opening balance, authorized draws, refills and separately
authorized releases. The ledger is not a second copy of unrestricted cash. Staff check
movement direction and account purpose when reconciling it, because a transfer into reserve
reduces available unrestricted money while raising reserve. Listing the transfer as both a
new collection and a refill would count the same movement twice in different roles.
A proposed reserve release remains a proposal until its separate authority is present. A
worksheet can show an amount above the ordinary target without establishing that the
surplus has been released. Likewise, the restoration of a lower target after cure does not
itself prove that a bank transfer occurred. The archive separates the target calculation,
approval to release and actual execution evidence.
When a draw has been authorized for a permitted current senior shortfall, the subsequent
refill uses the actual reduced reserve balance under the main sequence. Staff do not carry
the pre-draw balance into the refill calculation merely because it appeared in an earlier
draft. The records explain which balance was current at each step. This operational
guidance does not broaden the permitted draw purposes or permit junior interest, arrears or
fees to be funded from reserve.
APPENDIX H | DELINQUENCY DATA PREPARATION
The servicer's delinquency file is prepared from the observation records used for the
performance test. Staff retain the observations, the source dates and the calculation
supporting the reported average. A rounded presentation in a management slide does not
automatically replace the underlying test input. The analyst checks whether a label
describes a monthly observation, a three-month average or a projection before applying the
main trigger condition.
A data correction is recorded with its reason and source. For example, a receipt assigned
to the wrong equipment reference can distort the delinquency file even while total bank
cash remains correct. Correcting that assignment may change a performance measure without
creating any new collection. Cash reconciliation and performance measurement must therefore
be reviewed together but cannot be treated as interchangeable tests.
The file identifies which observations were used for a decision and preserves later
corrections separately. Staff cannot establish cure by selecting a favorable observation
and omitting an unfavorable intervening record. The main memorandum's
consecutive-observation condition continues to govern. A forecast that the average may
decline is planning information, not an observation date on which the performance trigger
has actually cleared.
DISTRIBUTION EXERCISE
Period collections are 140, opening unrestricted cash is 10, and tax escrow is 20. A signed
but unpaid sale is 30. The reserve balance is 15. The trustee requests 7 in fees, senior
current interest is 50, senior interest arrears are 10, and junior current interest is 25.
The three-month delinquency average is 4.2%. No reserve release instruction exists and no
other deductions apply.
APPENDIX I | TRIGGER STATUS REGISTER
The status register records when the performance trigger became active, which observations
supported that state and whether the cure test has subsequently been met. It should not
simply copy a green or red symbol from a presentation without the associated dates and
meaning. An active state and a new activation test are related but distinct questions;
staff must preserve the history needed to distinguish them.
For each distribution, the preparer links the state used in the worksheet to the relevant
status record. An old worksheet may show the trigger clear because it belonged to an
earlier period. Copying that worksheet's formatting into a new period does not establish
that the new period is clear. The reviewer checks the underlying observations and the state
transition, not merely the color or wording in a reused template.
When a disputed data item affects the status, the distribution file documents the
unresolved issue and the applicable decision process. This appendix does not invent a
waiver or permit a clerk to choose the state that gives a desired junior payment.
Historical status records remain available after cure so an auditor can understand why a
previous distribution was retained. Cure is a recorded condition under the main terms, not
a retroactive declaration that no trigger ever existed.
REPORTING REVIEW
The distribution notice should list cash available, each applied step, the ending reserve
and retained unrestricted cash. Amounts withheld from junior distribution are not a payment
to senior capital unless a separate capital repayment step is authorized. Staff should
retain the unapproved draft and the signed final notice with different version labels. A
reviewer may correct a transcription error before signing, but cannot move a restricted
escrow balance into the waterfall to make a draft reconcile. The cap applies to the current
trustee fee step; a requested fee above the cap is not permission to skip reserve
replenishment.
APPENDIX J | JUNIOR PAYMENT AND RETAINED CASH
The junior ledger separately tracks current interest, recorded unpaid junior interest and
amounts allocated to the junior capital account when the main sequence permits. A withheld
junior payment is not a completed distribution. It also does not automatically become
senior arrears or a repayment of senior capital. Staff preserve the obligation's class when
recording why money was not distributed.
While the trigger is active, the notice explains the retained unrestricted cash after the
permitted earlier steps. That retained balance should be identifiable in the closing cash
reconciliation and the next period's opening position. A narrative calling it reserved for
junior is not a completed transfer and does not create an automatic release instruction.
The cash remains classified according to the actual terms and recorded movements.
Junior investors may ask why a period with positive collections did not produce a junior
payment. The explanation points to the applicable state, the earlier priority steps and the
retained cash, rather than describing collections as guaranteed return. Staff do not invent
a future payment date or promise a yield from one period's worksheet. The main memorandum
determines the current distribution, and later distributions require their own
observations, cash position and approvals.
CURE AND RELEASE
An active trigger clears only after the three-month average is at or below 3.0% on two
consecutive monthly observation dates. One low month is insufficient. After cure, the
ordinary target of 40 applies, but any release of reserve above 40 still needs the separate
release instruction. Cure alone does not turn previously suspended junior interest into
senior arrears.
APPENDIX K | DRAW REQUEST PACKET
A reserve draw request identifies the specific current senior interest shortfall and shows
the cash position after the trustee fee step. The packet includes the source interest
register and the reserve balance available for review. A general statement that the trust
needs liquidity is insufficient to establish the permitted purpose. The reviewer checks the
requested use instead of assuming that any senior-labeled amount may be funded.
The two required approvals are recorded as distinct decisions with the packet version each
reviewer considered. A preparer cannot copy one approval into the other role's field. If
the packet changes materially after an approval, staff identify the change and obtain the
necessary review of the revised packet. The presence of a signature somewhere in the folder
is not enough to show that the final instruction was approved.
Execution evidence is linked to the authorized request, and the reserve ledger is updated
to reflect the actual movement. A canceled or rejected instruction remains visible but does
not reduce reserve as though money had left. The later refill calculation uses the
supported balance. The operational packet makes the draw reproducible without adding new
authorized purposes, dispensing with either approval or treating reserve money as new
period collections.
APPENDIX L | DRAFT DISTRIBUTION WORKSHEETS
Preparers may create several draft worksheets while reconciling an input discrepancy. Each
draft is labeled with its source snapshot and review status. A draft is useful working
material, but its existence does not establish a payment obligation different from the main
memorandum. The final signed worksheet identifies the actual inputs and supersedes the
draft for execution without deleting the earlier working history.
The reviewer checks formulas and business definitions together. A spreadsheet can add rows
correctly while using tax escrow as unrestricted cash or placing a junior amount ahead of
reserve. Conversely, a formula error can produce the wrong amount even when the preparer
selected the correct class of inputs. Review comments describe which problem occurred so
the correction addresses its cause rather than simply replacing the final cell with a
desired number.
Hidden rows, stale links and copied period labels are reviewed as potential sources of
discrepancy. A locked workbook does not prove that its formulas are correct. The final
allocation should be reproducible from the source cash, obligations, reserve state and
trigger state using the stated order. Staff retain the review conclusion and corrected
version, allowing later examination of both the accounting result and the evidence
supporting it.
RESERVE DRAW
A liquidity draw may cover a shortfall in senior current interest only, after the trustee
fee step. It cannot pay junior interest, senior interest arrears, or fees. The draw
requires both trustee and oversight officer approval. A draw reduces the reserve balance
used in the later refill step; it is not new period collections.
APPENDIX M | DISTRIBUTION NOTICE DELIVERY
The signed distribution notice states the period, applied cash total, allocations, reserve
movements and retained balance relevant to that decision. The notice is delivered through
the recorded channel with a copy preserved in the archive. A draft sent for discussion is
labeled draft so recipients do not reasonably confuse it with the execution notice. Staff
should be able to identify which notice was final without reading an informal conversation
thread.
Where a transcription error is discovered after dispatch, the correction identifies the
prior notice and the specific change. Staff check whether the error was only in the
presentation or also affected an executed payment. These are different consequences and
require different supporting records. A corrected notice cannot by itself reverse a
completed bank movement; any actual correction must be traceable through its own authorized
instruction and execution evidence.
The delivery log establishes what was sent and when, while the bank file establishes what
was paid. Neither substitutes for the other. A recipient's acknowledgement does not prove
that funds reached the recipient account, and a bank movement does not prove that all
disclosures in a notice were complete. The archive keeps both kinds of evidence so
operational completion can be assessed without turning a communication event into a
fictitious cash movement.
VERSION REGISTER
CE-8 released every residual to junior even when the trigger was active. CE-9 retains that
residual in unrestricted cash. The new rule applies to distribution periods ending on or
after 2026-09-01, including assets originated under CE-8. It does not reopen already
completed earlier distributions. Reserve targets and the cure test are unchanged.
APPENDIX N | ASSET TRANSFERS AND ORIGINATION HISTORY
Equipment assets can have origination records created under an earlier operational edition.
The asset history explains the underlying leases and service arrangements, but it does not
independently choose the distribution rule for a later period. Staff distinguish the
asset's origination date from the ending date of the distribution period when applying the
transition provision in the main memorandum.
A file transfer between service teams preserves the original source documents and their
dates. Copying an asset folder into a newly named directory is not a new origination event,
and scanning an old agreement does not alter its execution date. Equally, old asset
identifiers do not preserve a superseded residual distribution treatment for every future
period. The preparer records the applicable edition and the event that makes it applicable.
Completed historical distributions are retained as historical decisions. Staff do not
reopen them merely to make all archived notices use the same format or current terminology.
If a genuine correction is required, it is recorded as a correction with its basis, rather
than disguising a new worksheet as the original. The transition analysis needs both
business chronology and document identity; a filename prefix or software modification date
cannot replace either.
BOUNDARY
This memorandum contains no actual borrower identities, a tax withholding rate for
investors, or a projected equipment sale price. The fictional amounts do not establish an
investment yield, and a cash-flow calculation cannot supply missing tax terms.
APPENDIX O | EXTERNAL AUDIT WORKING PACK
The audit working pack provides the selected period's source cash reconciliation,
obligation registers, reserve history, trigger observations, signed worksheet, notice and
execution evidence. It is a collection of records for review, not a new instruction to
operate trust accounts. Audit comments are logged as findings or questions, with the
responsible record owner identified for a response.
The pack distinguishes a missing document from a document that exists but does not support
the claimed conclusion. An unsigned draft might explain how an analyst worked without
proving that the final decision was authorized. A report repeating the worksheet total is
not independent evidence of its inputs. Reviewers trace material claims back to the
underlying record instead of counting the number of documents that repeat the same figure.
Sensitive or unrelated asset details can be handled through the authorized audit process
without inventing identities in this fictional casebook. An extract should preserve
qualifications that affect interpretation and clearly state that it is an extract. The full
controlled record remains the reference for a disputed context. Audit convenience does not
permit staff to omit a reserve restriction or trigger qualification from the evidence
supplied for a distribution conclusion.
APPENDIX P | CLOSE OF PERIOD AND HANDOVER
After execution, the closing reconciliation accounts for actual payments, actual reserve
movements and the unrestricted cash retained. Outstanding instructions are listed
separately from completed movements. The next team's opening file should make it possible
to distinguish cash carried forward from new collections and to identify any failed payment
whose obligation still needs attention.
The handover note names unresolved issues and links their source records. It does not
create a power to settle them outside the main memorandum. A personal note that a manager
expected a cure next month remains a forecast, and a draft plan to sell equipment remains a
plan. Staff should not convert those expectations into current cash, a cleared trigger or
an authorized junior distribution merely to reduce the list of open items.
The completed period is archived with the edition, observation set and final worksheet
used. Later teams can learn from mistakes without rewriting the original chronology. If a
genuine subsequent event changes an outstanding balance, its effect is recorded in the
appropriate later reconciliation. The resulting chain explains both what was distributed
and what remained, preserving the distinction between current interest, arrears, capital,
reserve and unrestricted cash across the handover.

# 蒲灯差旅延误保障 PD-5

虚构保险条款，2026年6月1日起签发的新保单适用。保障对象是保单上列明的单次航段，联程票也须按航段识别。旅行取消、行李损失与本条延误定额给付不同，不能拿其他险种的宣传材料解释本条款。

## 延误口径

延误时长为航空公司最终实际起飞时间减保单记载的计划起飞时间，按完整分钟计算；不是到达时间差，也不是机场广播首次宣告的延误估计。改签航班须经承运人确认替代原航段后才沿用原计划时点。旅客自行放弃航段且无替代确认，不视为达到给付条件。

## 单航段定额表

| 完整延误分钟 | 定额给付 |
| --- | --- |
| 0—119 | 0元 |
| 120—239 | 300元 |
| 240及以上 | 700元 |

档位互斥，达到240分钟只给700元，不另加300元。每位被保险人每个保单年度所有航段合计上限1800元。

## 出险登记

登记时上传登机凭证、承运人出具的最终起飞证明及保单号；只有订票截图不足以证明完成登机。理赔员先检查航段号再检查时间，不能用同一天其他航班的运行记录代替。对时间记录有异议时保留原附件并发起承运人复核，复核期间案件列为待定，不按客户估计时长预付。

## 已知事件除外

投保时承运人已公开宣布该航段延误的，不承担该次延误责任；即使后来超过240分钟也不恢复责任。普通天气预警本身不等于承运人宣布航段延误。因机场关闭而被承运人取消且无法改签的航段，按取消险另行审核，本延误表不直接适用。

## 年度余量

本次实付取本航段定额与年度剩余额度较小者，年度余量在同一被保险人所有有效保单间合并核算，不因重买保单重置。示例：此前年度累计给付1500元，本次完整延误260分钟，且不存在已知事件除外。

## 申请与复核时限

航段完成后30个自然日内提交申请，缺件时一次告知；客户在告知后10个自然日内补齐，逾期转为关闭，可附合理说明申请重新开启。重新开启不自动认定赔付，仍需核验原航段条件和年度余量。

## 旧单说明

PD-4保单使用到达时点计算延误。2026年6月1日前已签发的保单在原有效期内仍按PD-4，不因出险日落在6月后就改用PD-5；6月1日起新签发或续保签发的单据采用PD-5。

## 内容范围

本摘录不包含具体承运人的实时航班动态、取消险赔偿额或被保险人的完整年度理赔记录。示例1500元为设定条件，不表示任何真实客户历史。

items.question: 砚汐入池后新折让使融资超额，何时重算、向谁通知、多久补足？未来订单能补池吗？

gold.referenceAnswer: 发现当日重算并通知保理风控岗，两个工作日内补款或补经审核合格应收；未来未确认订单不能补。
requiredFacts: 两个工作日内补款或合格替代应收
未确认未来订单不能补池

evidence.text: 核定后新增折让，须在发现当日重算对应发票净额并通知保理风控岗；若造成融资超额，两个工作日内补款或补入经审核合格的替代应收。未经确认的未来订单不能补池。替代应收仍走交付、确权、逾期和集中度检查，不因为用于补池就豁免其中任何一项。

items.answer: 核定后新增折让，须在发现当日重算对应发票净额，并通知保理风控岗；若因此造成融资超额，应在两个工作日内补款或补入经审核合格的替代应收。未经确认的未来订单不能补池；替代应收仍须经过交付、确权、逾期和集中度检查。

砚汐保理池手册 YX-6
2026年11月1日起核定的保理池适用。全部客户、发票和数值均为虚构。仅受让已交付并经买方确权的人民币应收账款；订单、预付款请求和未交付的形式发票均不合格。保理池额度是融资基础，不是承诺无条件买断每一笔债权。

合格净额计算顺序：从已确权发票面额中扣除已开红字或买方已确认的折让、已回款部分、超过90日逾期的余额，再对剩余净额执行买方集中度限制。恰好逾期90日仍可留池，逾期91日起排除；逾期从合同付款到期日次日算第1日。仅口头争议未形成确认折让时，先将该争议发票整笔挂起核查，不先把争议金额当已确认折让扣掉后继续融资。

买方集中度：单一买方留池金额不得超过集中度前全池合格净额的40%。超出部分不计入融资基础；集中度分母只计算一次，不因剔除超额而循环重算。关联买方按一个买方合并计算，买方名称拼写不同不自动视为独立客户。执行集中度限制不改变债权面额，只影响可融资基础。

融资上限=集中度后合格净额×80%−已占用融资本金，负数按零处理。未付保理服务费不作为已占用本金扣第二遍，服务费由独立结算单收取。额度核定时不预扣未来利息，实际提款仍须在有效可用额度内，核定通过不代表资金已划出。

池核定演练：买方甲已确权发票60万元，已确认折让10万元、已回款5万元，其他均未逾期；买方乙已确权未回款35万元，其中一张5万元发票已逾期91日；买方丙已确权未回款25万元，无折让无逾期。三买方互不关联，已占用融资本金40万元。无其他发票或争议，且全部已交付。

建池资料包括供货合同、交付签收、发票、买方确权回执和收款路径确认。经办员先按债权标识去重，再核对合同主体；同一发票被卖方重复上传到两个文件夹，不能以文件名不同形成两笔合格资产。确权回执需能指向发票和到期日，仅有买方盖章的空白页不能证明金额已确认。业务人员可补录文档索引，但不得改写买方回执原文。

买方付款日与银行入账日分开保存，只有保理专户实收并完成认领，才减少已占用融资本金。应收账款显示‘已安排付款’不等于已经回款；卖方自行拿其他资金提前归还贷款则按实际还款流水处理，不反过来把对应应收伪记为买方付款。买方一次合并付款包含多张发票时，优先依买方付款附言核销，附言不清再要求补充，不能由经办任意挑选逾期最短发票以美化逾期率。

每次核定保留集中度前净额、单买方上限和超额剔除明细。若某一买方因身份疑问挂起，只能在身份核查有结论后重新构建本次快照，不允许一边剔除疑问买方、一边沿用含该买方的旧分母。这里的‘不循环重算’针对同一次有效快照的超额处理，不允许跨不同基础快照复用分母。复核员核对每一版快照的来源时点，前日已核定额度并不能直接代表今日可提款额。

追索边界：有追索保理中，买方到期不付、贸易折让或虚假交付导致未收回时，卖方按通知回购相应债权。无追索保理只覆盖保单列明的买方破产信用风险，不覆盖贸易纠纷、交付瑕疵或卖方欺诈；这些情形仍向卖方追索。保单的等待期与赔偿比例另行约定，本手册未给出。

核定后新增折让，须在发现当日重算对应发票净额并通知保理风控岗；若造成融资超额，两个工作日内补款或补入经审核合格的替代应收。未经确认的未来订单不能补池。替代应收仍走交付、确权、逾期和集中度检查，不因为用于补池就豁免其中任何一项。

回款异常处置：买方误付卖方普通账户时，卖方须次工作日全额划至保理专户并提交原始收款凭证，不能先扣自己的其他费用。发现重复认领时先冻结相关核销记录，经复核恢复正确记录；这不等于冻结全池所有买方的正常回款。已实收但尚未能分配到具体发票的来款进入待认领科目，在完成认领前不先释放融资占用。

YX-5买方集中度为50%，YX-6降为40%。2026年11月1日及以后每次重新核定都用40%，包括此前已入池且仍存续的发票；旧合同不锁定50%。已执行完毕且无余额的历史核定不回溯重做。融资比例80%与91日起排除的规则未变。

本手册不公开真实买方银行账户、无追索保单赔偿比例或破产等待期。不得用80%的融资比例推断保险赔偿比例。示例确权不指向真实贸易或真实个人信息。

items.question: 澄屿开放日15:00整提交且当日到账，归当天吗？15:00整能撤当天已受理单吗？

gold.referenceAnswer: 提交须顺延下一符合条件的开放日，15:00整也不能撤当天已受理单；两处都不含边界。

evidence.text:
## 受理日与撤单

开放日15:00之前（不含15:00）提交且款项同日到账，以当日为T日；15:00及以后或款项次日到账，顺延至同时满足提交时点与到账条件的下一开放日。非开放日的申请排至下一开放日，实际开放日见另行公告。撤单须在受理日15:00之前完成，15:00整不能撤销。

items.answer: 15:00整提交不属于“15:00之前（不含15:00）”，因此不能归为当天，应顺延至同时满足提交时点与到账条件的下一开放日；15:00整也不能撤销当天已受理单，撤单须在受理日15:00之前完成。
